METEO/AC/15/2026
Bangladesh Meteorological Department
Special Weather Bulletin
Date: 15 June 2026, 06:00 AM
Subject: Heavy to very heavy rainfall over Sylhet region
Under the influence of a strong monsoon, heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely over Sylhet, Sunamganj and Moulvibazar districts during the next 24 hours. 150 mm rainfall may occur at places. Landslide may occur in the hilly areas.

METEO/AC/22/2026
Bangladesh Meteorological Department
Tropical Cyclone Warning Bulletin No. 8
Date: 20 May 2026, 12:00 PM
Subject: Depression over the north Bay
Maximum sustained wind speed may be 130 km/h in gusts. Danger signal number 7 for Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Bagerhat, Khulna and Noakhali districts.

METEO/AC/09/2026
Bangladesh Meteorological Department
Heat Wave Bulletin
Date: 21 April 2026, 09:30 AM
Subject: Heat wave over the country
A mild to moderate heat wave is likely to continue over the country for the next 3 days. Maximum temperature may reach 39.5 C in some places.
